tools.name: Web page fetch
tools.description: Read one HTTPS page or a compact RSS/Atom feed listing.
tools.instructions: Retrieve a specific URL when its content is needed. RSS/Atom returns titles, article URLs, dates and authors by default; request feedContent=full only when article bodies are needed. Use documentId and nextOffset to continue the same retained projection without fetching again; omit documentId to change feedContent. Assess completeness before another action. bytesDownloaded is network input, not model context size. Cite the URL when using the content.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset; use nextOffset from the previous result.

tools.name: Web page extract
tools.description: Read up to ten HTTPS pages or compact RSS/Atom feed listings independently.
tools.instructions: Retrieve supplied URLs and assess each result independently. RSS/Atom returns titles, article URLs, dates and authors by default; request feedContent=full only when article bodies are needed. Use documentId and nextOffset with the same single URL to continue retained text; omit documentId to change feedContent. Distinguish partial downloads from shortened previews. bytesDownloaded is network input, not model context size. Cite pages whose content supports the answer.

tools.name: Context retrieval
tools.description: Read and search original compressed tool results in the current context, and inspect compression savings.
tools.instructions: Compressed results may omit relevant information. Use read or search with their reference to inspect the original before exact counts, quotes, code edits, or conclusions about omitted content. Search without a reference to recover evidence after a summary; it scans paginated archives. Follow nextOffset to continue. Read offsets and match positions are original UTF-8 bytes; search offsets page ranked matches with a reference, archives without one. References cannot access another Chat, node or child context.

fields.label: Authority boundary
fields.help: Read only immutable evidence belonging to the current context.

fields.label: Maximum retrieval bytes
fields.help: Maximum serialized page size; the Agent output limit also applies.

pointer.description: Optional JSON pointer into the original result, such as /stdout or /content.
